investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a moderate risk score of 0.55 from the real-time ML model, but the graph neighborhood analysis reveals no multi-hop linked cards and only a single shared device count, indicating no evidence of a distributed device ring or account takeover network. The transaction amount of $30.91 is well below the $5,000 SAR threshold, and there is no evidence of geo-velocity anomalies or impossible travel. Historical precedents with similar risk scores and transaction profiles were cleared as benign after cardholder confirmation, supporting a low-risk assessment.
